chapter.verse: Topa aw, nang kong bel hi; hong maizumsak ngei kei in la, na thumanna tawh kei hong honkhia in!
Na bil hong ngat in la, hong hon pak in! Ka belh ding suangpi hong hi in la, kei hong dal ding munkip muan’huai hong hi in!
Hi hi, nang in ka suangpi leh ka munkip muan’huai na hi hi; nangma min ngaihsutna tawh kei hong kha-in lam hong lak in la,
keima belhpa na hih manin kei hong kisiahna ngenthang kisel panin hong la khia in.
Nangma khut sungah keimah kong ki-ap hi; Topa, a thuman Pasian aw, keimah nong tan zo hi.
Mawkna milim a thupi ngaihsutte na mudah hi; ahih hangin ke’n Topa ka muang hi.
Na itna kip hangin lungdamin ka kipak ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka thuakna mu khin-in, ka kamsiatnate nong don khin a,
galte khut sungah kei nong pia kei hi; mun tanzau-ah ka khe na dingsak hi.
Topa aw, genthei ka hih manin kei hong hehpih in; dahna tawh ka mit thuk a, ka lungsim leh ka pumpi zong gim ta hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka nuntakna dahna vive hi a, ka hunte khuisatna vive ahi hi; ka gentheihna hangin ka tha kiam a, ka guhte ngaam hi.
Ka langte khempeuh’ nuihsat hi-in, ka vengte tungah cikzet-huai ka hi a, ka meltheihte’ gimneih ka hi hi; konglak-a hong mute in kei hong pelin hong taisan uh hi.
Misi bangin kei hong kiphawk nawn lo hi; beel kitam khat tawh ka kibang hi.
Hi hi, mi tampi’ kihuauna ka za hi—mun citeng-ah launa om! kei langpangin amaute vaihawm khawmin, thah dingin kei hong sawm uh hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in nang kong muang hi, Topa aw, “Nangmah in keima Pasian na hi hi,” kong ci hi.
Ka hunte na khut sungah om hi; ka galte leh hong bawlsiate khut sung panin kei hong honkhia in!
Na nasempa tungah na mai taangsak in; na itna kip tawh kei hong gum in!
Topa aw, nang tung hong ngen ka hih manin kei hong maizumsak kei in, migilote maizumsak in la, amaute pau ding thei loin Leinuai-ah pai sak in.
Thumante lang pang a, kihihsak pau in, kiphatsakna leh simmawhna tawh kam a pau, zuauthu gen mukte pau thei lo sak in.
Nang hong zahtakte’ adinga na koihsa, nang hong belte’ adinga mite’ muhna-ah na bawl, na hoihna bangzah takin kicing!
Mite’ sawmsimna panin na omna huam sungah amaute na seel a, kitotna panin amaute na buk sungah muanhuai-in na kem hi.
Khuapi khat gal in a umcih bangin kei hong ki-umcih lai-in a itna kip a lamdangin kei tungah hong lak ahih manin Topa in thupha ngah ta hen.
Lauthawngna tawh, “Nangma muhna panin gamlapi-ah kei hong kinot khia hi,” ka ci khin hi. Ahih hangin nang tungah huhna kong nget ciangin ka thuumnate nang nong za hi.
Topa it un, ama misiangtho khempeuh aw! Thumante Pasian in kem a, ahih hangin a kiphatsak gamtatte nakpi takin thuk hi.
Topa a ngak mi khempeuh aw, na tha uh khauhsak-in, na lungsim uh hangsak ta un!
